question: Why do RF coxa MNs receive almost no non-hair-plate excitation: missing wiring, quiet partners, or a consequence of RF's weak hair plates (left-side extra excitation being hair-evoked)?
known_before_registration: Drive-asymmetry V1 result: A_ON window-mean other-excitatory g per coxa MN (best posterior MNs RF 0.18, LF 8.59, LH 22.08) and Step C pooled OFF/ON coxa MN rates. No A_OFF replay, partner attribution, W_pot or type table was computed.

sources.v1_module: malecns_backend.embodiment.coxa_drive_asymmetry (its protocol() hash lock; functions reused unchanged)

targets.best_mn: V1 result structural[leg].best_mn for every leg (RF 146868, LF 146498, LH 144071 are the label targets)
targets.pools: V1 posterior pools of all six legs (coxa_drive_asymmetry.leg_pools)

measures.replay: coxa_drive_asymmetry.replay on each arm for all pool MNs; compare_spikes status per arm
measures.E1: per (target m, presynaptic j with s_j = float32(pre_sign_j * psp_scale) > 0): contribution = float64(float32(w_jm * s_j)) * sum over j's delivered spikes (delivery tick = fired tick + delay_steps, within the run) of K(d) / n_window, K(d) = sum_{t=max(d,lo)}^{hi} decay^(t-d); sum check: hair + other from E1 equals replay float64 hair + other within 1e-6 relative (absolute 1e-9 when zero)
measures.other: excitatory partners that are not in the target's own-leg SNpp45 set
measures.E2: other split by presynaptic superclass, type, side (hair_plate_identity.side_of on annotations; None reported as 'unknown') and downstream status (floored direct edge, count >= min_synapses, from any own-leg SNpp45)
measures.E3: baseline = A_OFF value; hair_evoked = A_ON - A_OFF, per partner and in total
measures.E4: W_pot(m) = sum over other excitatory partners of float64(w_jm * s_j) (identical in both arms); rho = g_other / W_pot; log(g_other ratio) = log(W_pot ratio) [WIRING] + log(rho ratio) [ACTIVITY]
measures.E5: for each presynaptic type contributing other excitation to RF or LF best MN: weight onto each, and window rate of the type's right-side and left-side neurons in each arm
measures.pool: Q1-Q3 quantities recomputed on summed pool g_other and W_pot (descriptive only)

labels.integrity: arm, V1 result and Step C report hashes match; V1 protocol hash lock; engine weights/signs equal MaleCNSBrain on every edge into target MNs; replay REPLAY_EXACT or REPLAY_CLOSE in both arms; E1 sum check; A_OFF and A_ON identical external schedule and per-tick uniforms_sha256; no target MN forced. Else INCONCLUSIVE_INTEGRITY, no labels

Q1.HAIR_EVOKED: hair_evoked >= 0.5 x g_other(A_ON) on both LF and LH best MNs

Q2.rule: A_ON, RF vs LF best MNs, terms WIRING and ACTIVITY
Q2.WIRING_GAP: WIRING more negative and ACTIVITY not within 10% of it
Q2.ACTIVITY_GAP: ACTIVITY more negative and WIRING not within 10% of it
Q2.zero: g_other(RF) = 0 gives ACTIVITY = -inf (recorded as null) -> ACTIVITY_GAP unless W_pot(RF) = 0 too, which gives WIRING_GAP

Q3.CONSEQUENCE_OF_HAIR_PLATES: g_other A_OFF: RF >= 0.67 x LF, and A_ON: RF < 0.33 x LF

predictions: Recorded in the design doc: Q1 HAIR_EVOKED for LF (LH less certain); Q2 ACTIVITY_GAP; Q3 CONSEQUENCE_OF_HAIR_PLATES.
interpretation_limits: Passive replay of one seed of one assisted-posture context; attribution is not causal importance.
Connectome factors cannot separate real anatomy from reconstruction artifact.
Nothing changes the engine, weights, encoder or mappings.
single_run: Executed once after protocol, code and tests are committed; no reruns, no rule changes.
